text:
The response is clear, customer-friendly, and directly answers the question. It correctly explains that language models learn patterns from large amounts of text and that pretraining generally uses unlabeled data. However, it oversimplifies by calling language models purely “statistical” and saying they “only require unlabelled data,” which ignores modern neural architectures and later fine-tuning with labeled data. Still, for a non-technical audience, it is helpful and mostly accurate.

Rating: [[8]]
